expect(
      input.messages
        .filter(
          (message) =>
            message.role === 'reasoning' || message.role === 'assistant',
        )
        .map((message) => message.id),
    ).toEqual(
      requestIndex === 0
        ? []
        : [
            'reasoning-weather',
            ...weatherRounds
              .slice(0, requestIndex)
              .map(
                (_round, index) =>
                  `${firstInput.threadId}:message:${index * 2 + 1}`,
              ),
          ],
    )

expect(
    fifthInput.messages
      .filter(
        (message) =>
          message.role === 'reasoning' || message.role === 'assistant',
      )
      .map((message) => message.id),
  ).toEqual([
    'reasoning-weather',
